# Good First Issues

These are well-scoped tasks for new contributors. Pick any one,
comment on the issue to claim it, then open a PR.

| Issue | Difficulty | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Add `--min-length` and `--max-length` CLI flags for clip duration filtering | Easy | CLI |
| Write unit tests for the moment scoring engine | Easy | Testing |
| Add a `--dry-run` flag that shows which clips would be extracted without writing files | Medium | CLI |
| Add progress bar using Rich library for transcription and export stages | Medium | UX |
| Add Dockerfile for zero-dependency setup | Medium | DevOps |
| Add support for Vimeo URLs via yt-dlp | Easy | Feature |
| Write a comparison table: Clipify vs Opus Clip vs Munch | Easy | Docs |
| Add `--language` flag to pass Whisper language hint | Easy | Feature |
